## 1. What is Parently?

Parently is a platform that connects parents with other parents who can take care of each-others children. You can find a parent to take care of your children, or offer to take care of the children of others.

## 1. What are ParentlyCredits?

ParentlyCredits are the currency used to pay for the services on Parently. You can earn ParentlyCredits by taking care of the children of others, or purchase ParentlyCredits in the app.

## 2. How do I earn ParentlyCredits?

You can earn ParentlyCredits by taking care of the children of others. The amount of ParentlyCredits you earn is determined by the duration of the care and the number of children you take care of.

1 hour of care for 1 child results in 1 PC, so a 2-hour care for 2 children results in 4 PC.

## 3. How do I purchase ParentlyCredits?

It is not yet possible to purchase ParentlyCredits in the app. We are working on this feature and will inform you when it is available.
